q: For something dated 3 July 2024 — two days after the first change — what was the nightly lodging cap for a grade 2 traveller going to a band B2 destination? Use the version in force on that day.
log:
The nightly lodging cap for a grade 2 (G2) traveller to band B2 was **115 USD**, per the `hard-perdiem-v2` table in force from 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31 (which covers 3 July 2024).
